column1: # ESP-IDF partition table for OTA support on the dropbot board (ESP32-C6
# Two app slots (ota_0/ota_1) are cycled by the OTA service in
# src/tasks/ota_manager.rs. There is deliberately no `factory` partition: three
# app slots do not fit in 4 MB
column2: and dropping it leaves ~1.9 MB per slot instead

column1: # of the ~1.3 MB a three-way split would allow. A plain `espflash flash` targets
# ota_0 (espflash falls back to the first app partition)
# boots ota_0 when otadata is blank or invalid.
# This table must be passed explicitly when flashing
#   espflash flash --partition-table=partitions.csv --erase-parts=otadata <elf>
# `--erase-parts=otadata` matters during local development: without it
# whose otadata still points at ota_1 would keep booting the stale image there
# instead of the slot you just flashed.
# IMPORTANT: switching to this table from the default single-slot layout
# requires a full `espflash erase-flash` once
# regions may otherwise contain stale data left over from the old layout.
# Name
nvs
otadata
ota_0
ota_1
